senses.gloss: (cmp. ביג s. v. בָּאגָא) to break forth, come to the surface.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 53b">Succ. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>כרינן</he> … <he>ונַבְגֵּי מיא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ונפקי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 80; Tosaf. to <cite ref="Bekhorot 44b">Bekh. 44ᵇ</cite> <he>ונַבְעֵי</he>) we dig a little, and water bubbles forth.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:5">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>קברה והדר נבוג</he> he buried the skull, but it came up again; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 104a">ib. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>והדר נבג</he> (Mss. F. a. K.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 249:1">Yalk. Kings 249</cite> <he>נביג</he>.
